title: MLCC Predictor Framework Manifest
description: Per-framework descriptor for an HTTP-architecture predictor (sklearn, xgboost, tensorflow). Declares as DATA what varies by framework (model formats, pip dependencies, default format, test payload, base-image catalog) and references the handler.py that carries the imperative load/predict code. Consumed at generation time by src/lib/predictor-manifest-reader.js.

framework.description: Framework name; must equal the directory name (sklearn, xgboost, tensorflow).

display_name.description: Human-readable label shown in the interactive engine prompt (e.g. scikit-learn).

model_formats.description: File formats the framework can load (e.g. [pkl, joblib]). The CLI --model-format and the interactive prompt derive their accepted/offered set from this list.

default_model_format.description: The model format used when none is supplied. MUST be one of model_formats (enforced by the predictor-framework conformance test, which JSON Schema cannot express as a cross-field membership check).

pip_dependencies.description: Pinned pip requirement lines rendered into the generated requirements.txt framework section (e.g. scikit-learn==1.7.1).

base_image_catalog.description: Base-image catalog key the base-image-picker routes to. All HTTP predictors use the shared python-slim catalog.

handler.description: Filename of the handler module within this directory (handler.py). It is materialized into the generated project as code/model_handler.py.

test_payload.description: The sample /invocations request body do/test sends for this framework (a JSON string).
